newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP FIRST DAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP FIRST DAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the opening day of four-day Red Stripe Cup cricket matches on Friday:
In Bridgetown: Leeward Islands 339 (S.Williams 141; W.Reid 4-79) v Barbados.
In San Fernando, Trinidad: Jamaica 277-3 (I.Garrick 138 not out, J.Adams 66) v Trinidad and Tobago.
In Georgetown: Guyana v Windward Islands - no play because of rain.
